basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the department names or the age limit.

qualification.details: The notice prints cumulative essential credit points of 50 for Associate Professor and 20 for Assistant Professor – Grade I. | Detailed educational qualifications, experience and other criteria are as per the modified recruitment rules for Faculty in NITs under Schedule E of the first statutes of the NITs (amendment statutes 2017), issued vide Gazette of India No. 651 dated 24 July 2017, and the Ministry of Education clarification dated 16 April 2019, as amended from time to time. Preference will be given to candidates who have completed their UG/PG/Ph.D. in IIT/NIT/IIIT/CFIs. Candidates working as Engineers/Scientists in Research or Industrial organizations who meet all eligibility conditions can also apply, with proof of credentials certified through a competent authority. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from NIT Puducherry will not be considered, unless there is three years of outside experience after leaving the Institute. The qualification must be from a recognized University / Institute. | Candidates should check the official notification and the MoE notifications for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 13A2 (AGP Rs.9500) for Associate Professor; Pay Level 12 (AGP Rs.8000) for Assistant Professor – Grade I, in 7th CPC

how_to_apply: Fill the online application at nitpyrec.samarth.edu.in along with the necessary enclosures.
Pay the non-refundable application fee online through the same portal if it applies to your category (see the fee table below).
If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application with the application fee for each post; otherwise the application will be rejected.
Submit the online application on or before 12.12.2026. Applications received after the last date for any reason will not be considered.
Bring self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents on educational qualifications and experience to the interview.

Selection is in two phases. In the first phase, shortlisted candidates appear for a technical seminar in the area of their specialization in the respective department. The second phase is an interview by the duly constituted Selection Board.
Meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to a call letter.

To limit applicants to a reasonable number, the Institute may set higher scrutiny norms than the minimum prescribed. The area of specialization and the post/level applied for are considered while shortlisting, and different departments may have different shortlisting criteria.
The Screening Committee reserves the right to call or not to call candidates for the selection process.

The shortlist will be displayed on the Institute website. No separate call letters will be sent; only email intimation will be given to the concerned candidates. The name or application number of shortlisted candidates will be shown on www.nitpy.ac.in.
important_instructions: Candidates employed in Govt./Semi Govt./any organization should submit an NOC online or at the time of interview through proper channel. Applications of those with pending vigilance/disciplinary cases will not be considered or scrutinized. Incomplete applications will be rejected outright, and candidates not eligible for the post applied for will not be considered. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of the information provided. Incorrect or false information found later makes the candidate liable for criminal action. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The Institute may modify, defer or cancel the recruitment at any stage, or not fill the posts, without assigning any reason. No interim communication on application status, and no correspondence on the conduct or result of the interview, will be entertained. Any corrigendum will be published on the Institute website only. Disputes are subject to Courts / Tribunals having jurisdiction over Karaikal.

rows.details: National Institute of Technology Puducherry, Thiruvettakudy, Karaikal
Associate Professor; Assistant Professor – Grade I (faculty in various departments)
Pay Level 13A2 (AGP Rs.9500) for Associate Professor; Pay Level 12 (AGP Rs.8000) for Assistant Professor – Grade I, in 7th CPC

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints cumulative essential credit points of 50 for Associate Professor and 20 for Assistant Professor – Grade I. Detailed educational qualifications, experience and other criteria are as per the modified recruitment rules for Faculty in NITs under Schedule E of the first statutes of the NITs (amendment statutes 2017), issued vide Gazette of India No. 651 dated 24 July 2017, and the Ministry of Education clarification dated 16 April 2019, as amended from time to time. Preference will be given to candidates who have completed their UG/PG/Ph.D. in IIT/NIT/IIIT/CFIs. Candidates working as Engineers/Scientists in Research or Industrial organizations who meet all eligibility conditions can also apply, with proof of credentials certified through a competent authority. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from NIT Puducherry will not be considered, unless there is three years of outside experience after leaving the Institute. The qualification must be from a recognized University / Institute. Candidates should check the official notification and the MoE notifications for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.experience: Six years after Ph.D. of which at least 03 years at the level of Assistant Professor with AGP Rs.8000/-; OR nine years total working experience, of which 03 years should be after Ph.D., with at least 03 years at the level of Assistant Professor with AGP Rs.8000/-.
Three years after Ph.D. or six years total teaching and research experience in reputed academic Institute or Research and Development Labs or relevant industry.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Institute reserves the right to rectify any discrepancy in the pay or Pay Level, if found later. The number of vacancies is tentative, and NIT Puducherry reserves the right to change the number of advertised posts at the time of selection. For departments with no vacancy, movement in higher academic grade pay or cadre will be carried out as per the specified selection process, restricted to serving faculty members of the respective departments of NIT Puducherry (note 1, point 5 of Schedule E of the NIT Statutes, Amended 2017). No TA/DA will be paid for attending any stage of the selection process. Reservation for faculty positions applies as per the directives of the Ministry of Education, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of documents on educational qualifications and experience, at the time of interview. Original documents supporting the particulars in the application (reservation category, educational qualification, experience and other claims), for candidates called for interview. SC/ST candidates: valid certificate issued by the concerned authority. PWD candidates with 40% and above: medical certificate in the prescribed form from the competent medical authority. OBC candidates: OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 in the Central Government format (format attached to the notice), failing which the candidate is considered under Unreserved category. EWS candidates: Income and Assets certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 in the Central Government format (format attached), failing which the candidate is considered under Unreserved category.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Puducherry faculty recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application with all necessary documents is 12 December 2026. Applications received after that date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts has NIT Puducherry advertised?
faq.answer: The advertisement is for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor – Grade I in various departments at Thiruvettakudy, Karaikal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require a Ph.D. Associate Professor also needs six years after Ph.D. (at least 3 years as Assistant Professor with AGP Rs.8000/-) or nine years total experience as printed. Assistant Professor – Grade I needs three years after Ph.D. or six years teaching and research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay for the posts?
faq.answer: Associate Professor is at Pay Level 13A2 (AGP Rs.9500) and Assistant Professor – Grade I at Pay Level 12 (AGP Rs.8000) in the 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- (non-refundable) for UR/OBC/EWS, paid online. SC/ST/PWD categories and Female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the online application at nitpyrec.samarth.edu.in along with the necessary enclosures before 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application with the application fee must be submitted for each post, or the application will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is in two phases: a technical seminar in the area of specialization for shortlisted candidates, then an interview by the Selection Board.

faq.question: Q9. Can an NIT Puducherry Ph.D. holder apply?
faq.answer: Not unless there is three years of outside experience after leaving the Institute. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from NIT Puducherry are otherwise not considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending any stage of the selection process.
